learned: An LLM call is one HTTP request: the whole conversation goes in as JSON, and one message comes back.
The model doesn't remember anything between calls. Memory is just the list of messages we send every time.
Reasoning is extra tokens the model writes before its answer. reasoning_effort turns it on or off, and the reasoning comes back in its own field.
A skill is a prompt saved to a markdown file and added to the system prompt. ChatUI re-reads the file on every message.
In the manual agent, the tutor can only write out the log_session(...) call. I have to paste it into a cell and run it myself.
